name: R11 M4 Assault Spear of Hero Ziol

system.description:
Your "Round Windmill" is treated as having +1 SR (it may exceed its max SR). (Self: Riding) +2D to damage rolls. The great silver spear said to have been used by the hero Geor. Magical silver circuits allow light and magical energy to flicker and be released from the spear.

Rusted Holy Symbol [Core Material] (240G) + Partisan (350G) + War Horse Horn (360G) + [Magic Catalyst 11] (120G) + Crafting Cost (370G)
